nodes.name: ReadPriceNotice

nodes.role: ask the user to approve the shortfall amount and the Spotify payee before any money moves

nodes.name: PaySpotifyShortfall
nodes.role: send the approved shortfall amount to Spotify only

nodes.name: ReportResult
nodes.role: report to the user whether the shortfall payment succeeded or failed
